summary: Frontend-only audit for em-dash (—) and en-dash (–) removal across guest-facing pages. All 11 target pages (/, /about-the-chef, /supper-club/naani-ghar, /supper-club/barsaat, /supper-club/when-there-wasnt-enough, /events, /menus, /menus/naani-ghar, /menus/barsaat, /menus/when-there-wasnt-enough, /suppers) rendered ZERO em-dash and ZERO en-dash characters in document.body.innerText.
